No corrections since no existing fact contradicts.

Hmm, "depends_on" — the notifier pushes to the provider; whether it depends on it is an inference. But retrying failed pushes implies the pushes go through the provider. I'll add rel_kind "pushes_to" with evidence "retry failed pushes three times" — actually the strongest evidence: "the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages". I'll use rel_kind "pushes_to".

Confidence: 0.9 for the decision; 0.8 for the historical fact.
